text5520009668863520.text:
Power-PRO 2

Powered ambulance cot

Lift, lower and transport with confidence. Power-PRO 2 is the first connected ambulance cot, built for the relentless workload of emergency response.

text_33709442.text:
You live it. We built it.

No one knows what works in the field better than you. That’s why Power-PRO 2 builds on a proven, field-tested design—so you can focus on your patients, support your crew and stay ready for whatever comes next.

text_copy.text:
Respond confidently

  • Reach optimal transport height with a single button and increase maneuverability using an extended transport handle
  • Navigate through tighter quarters with a new retractable foot section (extends and retracts an extra three inches each)
  • Help decrease body fatigue with enhanced ergonomics during manual loading and unloading

standaloneimage.alt: Firefighter EMS pulling a patient on a Power-PRO 2 from a night time car crash

text_copy.text:
Respond safely

  • Perform a true, unassisted lift and reach optimal loading height using hydraulic assembly with load-sensing capabilities
  • See and be seen in low light environments with powerful lights and reflectors
  • Designed to reduce the chance of cot damage and medic or patient injury with new bumper detection technology

standaloneimage_copy.alt: EMS responding to an unconscious patient with a cardiac emergency on a pier with the Power-PRO 2

text_copy.text:
Respond ready

  • Remotely track your fleet with Smart Equipment Management (SEM) and pinpoint your cot with its last-known location*
  • Improve battery life and management with a new lithium-ion battery and charge indicator
  • Limit cot downtime, reduce unexpected costs and ready your ambulances

standaloneimage.alt: A close up shot of Power-PRO 2's battery charge indicator at the foot of the cot

text.text:
Respond to every patient

  • Transport pediatric patients from 4 to 108 lb with Mini-PRO, our pediatric restraint for emergency cots
  • Set up Mini-PRO in 60 seconds or less with color-coded restraints and D-rings designed for quick, intuitive assembly
  • Support pediatric transport with a restraint crash tested to globally recognized standards
  • Support co-transport with a parent for children 4 to 22 lb, helping keep caregiver and child together during transport
  • Maintain access to the patient’s chest with an unfastened chest buckle closure while the restraint remains crash tested

standaloneimage.alt: A mother riding the Power-PRO 2 stretcher toward an ambulance while comforting her crying baby that is in the Mini-PRO pediatric restraint

text_copy.text: Explore what makes Power-PRO 2 built for you

standaloneimage.alt: The Power-PRO 2 powered ambulance cot image surrounded by 7 product features which are linked to an interactive experience

text_1906314488.text:
The industry's first connected ambulance cot

With Smart Equipment Management, automatically track cot health and remotely manage your fleet through one convenient, interactive dashboard.

Learn more

standaloneimage.alt: The Smart Equipment Management (SEM) interactive dashboard on a computer and tablet screen

text.text:
• Optimize the life of your equipment by evaluating cot usage and rotating your fleet
  • Identify training opportunities with detailed analytics to help support patient and medic safety
  • Take the guesswork out of battery replacement by monitoring use over time

text_copy.text:
• Keep your fleet ready to respond by identifying which cots need attention
  • Save time and budget by troubleshooting issues before on-site repair
  • Get equipment back in the field with direct access to ProCare Services

• Start your shift with battery status updates and other critical cot insights
  • Pinpoint your fleet in near real-time with last-known location*
  • Streamline reporting and planning requirements with instant access to vital equipment metrics

text.text: ​*Receive location updates when connected to an active Wi-Fi network and inductive charger from Power-LOAD or Performance-LOAD. Hot spot required for off-network use (not provided by Stryker). Frequency of updates depends on your connection.

text_494322183.text:
Proven customer satisfaction

EMS personnel face significant physical demands on the job, and repetitive lifting and loading can put considerable strain on the body.1,2 Powered cot and loading systems are designed to help reduce that physical burden, helping your team respond confidently and safely.³ 

We surveyed 949 Power-PRO and Power-LOAD product users across 39 states nationwide.4

text2728424019750174.text:
98% 

agree that Stryker's Powered System has made their job easier.4

86% 

agree that Stryker's Powered System has improved their job satisfaction.4

74% 

agree they are more likely to work at a service with Stryker's Powered System.4

text.text: Yes. The Power-PRO 2 cot is 8.4% lighter than a comparable Power-PRO XT configuration.

text_copy.text: Stryker's Power-PRO 2 powered ambulance cot can support and transport a maximum weight of 700 lb (318 kg).

The Power-PRO 2 has been dynamically crash tested to meet SAE J3027, BS EN 1789 and AS/NZS 4535 when used with Power-LOAD or Performance-LOAD fasteners, Stryker's X Restraints and Universal Floorplate. The Power-PRO 2 also meets IEC 60601-1 tip stability guidelines.

text.text: The lithium-ion battery has a two-year expected service life under normal use conditions. The battery charger has a seven-year expected service life under normal use conditions.

text_copy.text: Stryker sales representatives deliver hands-on training for Power-PRO 2 purchases.

text_copy.text: Power-PRO 2 is compatible with Stryker's Power-LOAD powered cot fastener, Performance-LOAD manual cot fastener, mass casualty fastener, wall mount fastener and floor mount fastener.

text_copy_copy.text: Our implementation team can connect your cots to the LIFENET Portal. Contact your Stryker sales representative for more information.

Power-PRO 2 introduces several enhancements, including bumper detection technology, a three-position foot section, transport height indicator, extended transport handle and Smart Equipment Management (SEM).
